notes.title: First Quarter Update
notes.content:
Resolved issue where some players were experiencing problems saving the game. All players should no longer experience any problems regarding their saved files. 

Reworked the optimization of the project. The game should run much smoother than before. 

Changes to cinematics.

Temporarily removed the selection of different outfit colors. This feature will return when all issues are fixed.

notes.title: Brushlings Pale Moon - Live Demo & First Area of the game playthrough
notes.content:
Broadcast Link: https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199085058716

Join creator, Benjamin Boese, as he live streams the demo for Brushlings and talks a bit about the game and development process of how the world of Brushlings was created.

SCHEDULE

12:00 - 12:15 PM CDT - Demo Playthrough (Benjamin plays through the demo and talks about the game)

12:15 - 1:00 PM CDT - Brushlings Playthrough (Benjamin plays through the first level of the game and discusses the goals of the finished product and more!)

1:00 - 1:15 PM CDT -  Open Q&A

More details about the game can be found on our website below.
[url=https://brushlings.com/]BRUSHLINGS WEBSITE[/url]

notes.title: Brushlings Pale Moon - First Glance
notes.content:
Broadcast Link: https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199085058716?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_

Join creator, Benjamin Boese, as he live streams the playthrough of the opening section of the game. You'll get a first glimpse of what the environment will look like and how to navigate through the opening of the game.

SCHEDULE

12:00 - 12:05 PM EST - Introduction (A brief introduction from Benjamin and minor details about the game's)

12:05 - 1:45 PM EST - Demo Playthrough (Benjamin plays through the first level of the game and discusses the goals of the finished product and more!)

12:45 - 1:00 PM EST - Open QA

You're welcome to post any questions in the chat, Benjamin Boese, will be able to answer any questions you have there.

More details about the game can be found on our website below.
BRUSHLINGS WEBSITE
